name: my-pr-board
description: A pane beside the chat tracking the pull requests this session raised: each stack bottom first, with GitHub's live state for every pull request, draft or ready, merged or closed, CI, conflicts, review and the threads waiting on you, plus Claude's one-line note on what is left. Pull requests opened with gh pr create join on their own. Each session keeps its own board, restored on resume. /myprs opens it.
